concerns.text: Task T022a restricts Benjamini-Hochberg correction to 'only taxa-level p-values', explicitly excluding alpha diversity and PERMANOVA results. This violates Spec FR-005 which mandates correction for 'multiple hypothesis testing across all taxa' (implying the full set of tests in US-2) and contradicts Constitution Principle VII which requires BH correction for 'all correlations... across taxa'. The task silently weakens the statistical rigor requirement by leaving alpha diversity correlations uncorrected.

Task T020a contains a hard constraint: 'Do NOT use linear modeling (MaAsLin2) here; strictly follow the partial Spearman requirement'. This contradicts Plan.md Phase 2 which explicitly selects 'MaAsLin2-style linear modeling (or skbio equivalent)' as the methodology. While Spec FR-004 allows partial Spearman, the Plan made a specific methodological choice to use MaAsLin2-style modeling for covariate adjustment. The task unilaterally reverts to a different method without a spec amendment, violating the Plan's methodological commitment.

Spec FR-003 requires calculating beta diversity metrics including 'UniFrac'. Tasks T016c and T016d generate Weighted and Unweighted UniFrac matrices. However, there is no downstream task to perform PERMANOVA or other statistical tests on these UniFrac matrices. The Plan Phase 2 Task 2.3 mentions PERMANOVA on 'beta diversity' but the tasks only implement it for Bray-Curtis (T021). This results in the UniFrac requirement being generated but never utilized for the core analysis, effectively dropping the 'UniFrac' part of the FR-003 acceptance criteria for the final results.

Task T030b introduces a 'Reference-Validator Agent' to run on external cohort URLs (UK Biobank, MetaHIT) as a 'Constitution Gate'. The Spec and Plan do not define a 'Reference-Validator Agent' as a required system component or task. Introducing an external agent dependency not present in the spec/plan constitutes a silent drift in the system architecture and violates the principle that tasks must not introduce unverified external dependencies or paid models (Constitution Principle II) without explicit specification.

Task T037 measures pipeline runtime by parsing `logs/pipeline.log` for start/end timestamps. Spec SC-004 requires measuring the 'computational runtime of the full analysis pipeline'. The task relies on the assumption that T005 (logging infrastructure) correctly tags every phase start/end with millisecond resolution. There is no explicit task to instrument the *entry* and *exit* of the main pipeline wrapper script to guarantee the 'full pipeline' duration is captured. If the log parser misses edge cases (e.g., script crash before log write), the SC-004 verification fails silently, weakening the acceptance criterion.
